display.purpose: Day numbers, wordmarks, graduation headlines. One per screen — the number or word that matters most.

title.purpose: Screen title, day title on DayCard. One per screen.

heading.purpose: Question headings in onboarding, WHY THIS MATTERS header.

quote.purpose: Inspirational quotes in day content. Present without dominating.

base.purpose: Button labels, short UI paragraphs, navigation metadata.

body.purpose: Long-form content: why_text, onboarding hints, profile info.

step.purpose: StepCard instruction text in WHAT TO DO sections.

caption.purpose: Timestamps, subtrack name, duration on DayCard metadata row.

label.purpose: SectionLabels, badge text. Always uppercase. Never lowercase.

shadows.name: glowCta
shadows.purpose: Primary Button and HoldButton in active/holding state. The action available right now.

shadows.name: glowSurge
shadows.purpose: Recommended TrackCard, selected OptionCard halo. 'This is the one.'

motion.name: entrance
motion.value: duration: 400ms | from: { opacity: 0, translateY: 20 } | to: { opacity: 1, translateY: 0 } | easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic)
motion.purpose: Standard screen and card entrance. Every screen and card list.

motion.name: staggerDelay
motion.purpose: Delay between staggered list items (OptionCards, StepCards, TrackCards, SubtrackCards).

motion.name: selectionSpring
motion.purpose: Checkmark spring-in/out, tab icon scale, button press return, TrackCard/SubtrackCard press scale.

motion.name: pressScale
motion.purpose: Scale on press. Cards (TrackCard, SubtrackCard, OptionCard) use 0.985; primary Button uses 0.97.

motion.name: heartbeatPulse
motion.purpose: HoldButton idle state. Signals the button is alive and waiting. Suppressed on prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: dotStretch
motion.purpose: StepDots current indicator stretching from dot to pill.

motion.name: ghostEntrance
motion.value: opacity: 0→0.04 over 600ms | translateY: 8→0 over 800ms | withTiming | ReduceMotion.System
motion.purpose: GhostNumber entrance on onboarding question screens. Opacity settles at 4% — present but silent.

motion.name: silhouetteFloat
motion.value: translateY: 0→-8→0 | duration: 4000ms | easing: easeInOut | repeat: infinite
motion.purpose: Silhouette component float on Ascent and Graduation screens.

motion.name: shakeError
motion.purpose: OptionCard when 3rd selection attempted. Input fields on failed form submission.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action on a given screen. Surge fill, CTA glow, holds the system weight.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #3DF5A6; color: #07090D; height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 28px; border: none; font-family: 'HankenGrotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), box-shadow 0.2s ease; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(61,245,166,0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(0.98); box-shadow: 0 0 28px rgba(61,245,166,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled, .ds-btn-primary[aria-disabled='true'] { opacity: 0.2; cursor: default; box-shadow: none; transform: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost button — steps back and lets primary lead. Borders in dim white.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.60); height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 28px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); font-family: 'HankenGrotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.22); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.80); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: default; }

components.name: Option Card
components.description: Selectable answer in onboarding. Default is dark and quiet; selected electrifies with Surge.
components.html: Move my body more consistently
components.css: .ds-option-card { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; background: #0F141A; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px 20px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease, transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1); } .ds-option-card:hover { background: #13191f; } .ds-option-card:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-option-card--selected { background: rgba(61,245,166,0.06); border-color: rgba(61,245,166,0.40); } .ds-option-card--selected .ds-option-label { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.95); } .ds-option-card--disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: default; pointer-events: none; } .ds-option-label { font-family: 'HankenGrotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.60); } .ds-option-check { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0); transition: opacity 0.15s ease, transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-option-card--selected .ds-option-check { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }

components.name: Track Card
components.description: Track selection on the Match screen. Horizontal row: icon container + name/tagline + optional Recommended badge. Recommended variant glows.
components.html:
MindfulYou already know what's good. Learn to feel it again.
RECOMMENDED
components.css: .ds-track-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: rgba(61,245,166,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(61,245,166,0.40); border-radius: 20px; padding: 20px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease, transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1); box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(61,245,166,0.18); } .ds-track-card:not(.ds-track-card--selected):not(.ds-track-card--recommended) { background: #0F141A; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); box-shadow: none; } .ds-track-card:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-track-icon { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 14px; background: rgba(61,245,166,0.12); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-track-icon--default { background: #10161D; } .ds-track-copy { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-track-name { font-family: 'HankenGrotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.95); } .ds-track-tagline { font-family: 'HankenGrotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.60); line-height: 1.4; } .ds-badge-recommended { flex-shrink: 0; background: #3DF5A6; border: 1px solid #3DF5A6; border-radius: 28px; padding: 3px 8px; font-family: 'HankenGrotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.10em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #07090D; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Subtrack Card
components.description: Subtrack selection on the Focus screen. Name left, status badges right. Three states: selectable, locked (Pro), not live.
components.html: Morning Clarity
components.css: .ds-subtrack-card { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; background: rgba(61,245,166,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(61,245,166,0.40); border-radius: 20px; padding: 20px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease, transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1); } .ds-subtrack-card--default { background: #0F141A; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); } .ds-subtrack-card--not-live { background: #0F141A; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); opacity: 0.4; cursor: default; pointer-events: none; } .ds-subtrack-card:active:not(.ds-subtrack-card--not-live) { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-subtrack-name { font-family: 'HankenGrotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.95); } .ds-subtrack-card--not-live .ds-subtrack-name { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); } .ds-subtrack-badges { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-badge-pro { background: #FF4FD8; border: 1px solid #FF4FD8; border-radius: 28px; padding: 2px 6px; font-family: 'HankenGrotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.10em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #07090D; } .ds-badge-coming-soon { background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09); border-radius: 28px; padding: 3px 8px; font-family: 'HankenGrotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.10em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); }

components.name: Ghost Number
components.description: Absolutely-positioned decorative numeral behind onboarding question headings. 4% opacity. Non-interactive. Pure spatial rhythm.
components.html:
02

Honestly — where are you running on right now?
components.css: .ds-ghost-number-wrap { position: relative; margin-top: 44px; } .ds-ghost-number { position: absolute; inset: 0; font-family: 'HankenGrotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 120px; font-weight: 900; color: white; opacity: 0.04; line-height: 120px; pointer-events: none; user-select: none; animation: ghost-enter 0.8s ease-out forwards; } @keyframes ghost-enter { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); } to { opacity: 0.04; transform: translateY(0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-ghost-number { animation: none; } } .ds-ghost-heading { position: relative; z-index: 1; font-family: 'HankenGrotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.95); margin: 0; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard content card. Fathom fill, hairline border. No blur, no glassmorphism.
components.html: Rest is not a reward. It's part of the protocol.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #0F141A; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-radius: 20px; padding: 20px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'HankenGrotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.55; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.95); margin: 0; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input — near-invisible fill, hairline border, Surge glow on focus.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { position: relative; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-radius: 14px; padding: 14px 16px; font-family: 'HankenGrotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.95); outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.22); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(61,245,166,0.10); } .ds-input--error { border-color: #E24B4A; } .ds-input--error:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(226,75,74,0.15); }

components.name: Bottom Nav
components.description: Fixed tab bar. bgNav fill with BlurView behind on iOS. Active tab takes the current phase color. Never shown on Day or Graduation screens.

components.name: Step Dots
components.description: Onboarding progress indicator. Current step stretches to a pill; past steps are Arc-Light dots; future steps are dim.
components.css: .ds-step-dots { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-dot { height: 5px; border-radius: 3px; transition: width 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), background-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-dot--past { width: 5px; background: #EAFFF5; } .ds-dot--current { width: 16px; background: #EAFFF5; } .ds-dot--future { width: 5px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-dot { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
INAT is where commitment becomes physical. The interface does not welcome or comfort — it witnesses. Every screen is built for a specific moment: the 5am moment when the alarm goes off, when inspiration has left the building, and what remains is the system. Hanken Grotesk rendered black-weight on near-total-dark communicates one thing: this is not decorative. The three phase colors — Glacial, Surge, Plasma — are not branding choices. They are a progress arc. When the user reaches Plasma, they earned it by living through Glacial and Surge first.

The design carries the INAT philosophy structurally. The HoldButton cannot be tapped — it must be held. The graduation moment requires three beats before the user can leave. Day unlocks are calendar-gated, not timer-gated. These are not UX patterns; they are the design asserting that things worth doing require more than a tap.

The palette is closed. No new colors are added. The accents are in limited supply — Surge appears on a CTA, a selected state, a phase indicator. Its rarity is its weight. A screen where Surge is everywhere has lost the argument. A screen where Surge appears once, on the one thing that matters, wins.
keyCharacteristics: Near-total dark surface — Abyss (#07090D) everywhere except elevated cards (Fathom, #0F141A).
Three phase accents a user earns sequentially, not decoratively.
Single typeface (Hanken Grotesk), enormous weight range — Black (900) for display, Regular (400) for body. Contrast through weight, not typeface variety.
Glow, not shadow — elevation via phase-colored glow on selected/active states only. Static cards are silent.
Motion is ritual, not decoration — holds, springs, staggered lists, ghost entrances, silhouette lighting — each animation has one reason.
Minimum 44pt touch targets (iOS) / 48dp (Android). HoldButton centered for ambidextrous access.

rules.name: The Closed Palette Rule
rules.body: The palette is locked. The three phase accents (Surge, Glacial, Plasma) map one-to-one with the three phases of the 21-day journey. Adding a fourth accent dissolves that architecture. No new colors — ever.

rules.name: The Accent Economy Rule
rules.body: Any given screen contains one phase accent, appearing in ≤3 places. A screen where Surge appears on five elements has failed the design. Its rarity is the argument.

rules.name: The No Pure White Rule
rules.body: Pure #FFFFFF is prohibited. Body text uses text-hi (rgba(255,255,255,0.95), hex #FFFFFFF2). Near-white moments use arc-light (#EAFFF5).

rules.name: The One Font Rule
rules.body: Hanken Grotesk is the only typeface. Never add a second family. Weight, size, and letter-spacing provide all necessary variation.

rules.name: The Weight-First Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is established by weight before size. Never reach for a larger size when a heavier weight conveys hierarchy more efficiently.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Drop shadows are prohibited. Glow — a colored radial emanation — earns its place because it carries phase meaning. The color tells you where in the journey you are.

rules.name: The Static Silence Rule
rules.body: Glow appears only on interactive states (selected, holding, recommended). Inert cards carry only a hairline border-card. Nothing glows without a reason.

rules.name: The No-Tap Rule for HoldButton
rules.body: The primary day-completion action requires a 1-second hold, not a tap. Never replace HoldButton with a standard tap Button for day completion. The friction is the design.

rules.name: The No Glassmorphism Rule
rules.body: Blur on card surfaces is prohibited. BlurView appears only behind BottomNav on iOS because it is a floating OS element. Cards never blur.

rules.name: The One Per Screen Rule (GhostNumber)
rules.body: One GhostNumber per question screen — never stacked, never on non-question screens. It is spatial rhythm, not repeated decoration.

rules.name: The Badge Economy Rule
rules.body: One badge per list item, two badges maximum per card. Stacking three variants on a single card breaks hierarchy.

dos: Do use text-hi (rgba(255,255,255,0.95) / #FFFFFFF2) or arc-light (#EAFFF5) for all primary text. Pure #FFFFFF is prohibited.
Do apply only the current phase accent on any given screen — Glacial for days 1–7, Surge for 8–14, Plasma for 15–21.
Do anchor HoldButton in a fixed-position View at screen bottom, outside any ScrollView, always.
Do convey elevation through background lightness (Abyss → Fathom → Raise) and phase-colored glow for interactive states only.
Do use Reanimated 3 for all animations. React Native's Animated API is prohibited.
Do keep the current phase accent to ≤3 appearances per screen.
Do respect safe-area insets on iOS (Dynamic Island, notch, home indicator) and Android (status bar, nav bar, display cutout, IME).
Do maintain 44pt minimum touch targets on iOS, 48dp on Android.
Do call Supabase exclusively from services/ — never from a component.
Do apply glowSurge to the recommended TrackCard — it is the only unsolicited glow in the system.
donts: Don't build a wellness or meditation aesthetic. No Headspace beige, no soft pastels, no breathing-room whitespace as a substitute for meaning.
Don't build a corporate productivity tool. No Notion neutrals, no Linear precision-grid, no checkbox energy.
Don't use motivational poster copy or imagery. No mountains, no 'you got this,' no abstract uplift.
Don't use glassmorphism on card surfaces. Blur is permitted only behind BottomNav on iOS.
Don't use drop shadows. Phase-colored glow or nothing.
Don't show BottomNav on the Day screen or Graduation screen.
Don't put HoldButton inside a ScrollView.
Don't add a new color to the palette.
Don't use any in TypeScript. Fix the type.
Don't put a border-left stripe wider than 3dp on a card decoratively. The Card accent variant's left strip is a phase signal — never used without phase meaning.
Don't stack more than one GhostNumber per screen. One question, one ghost.
Don't use glowSurge on more than one TrackCard per list. The recommendation is singular.
